newsitem.title: USA: Household Int'l sues Shell Oil, Hoechst Celanese.
newsitem.headline: Household Int'l sues Shell Oil, Hoechst Celanese.

text.p: Household International Inc has sued Royal Dutch/Shell Group unit Shell Oil Co and the Hoechst Celanese Corp unit of Hoechst AG.

In information papers filed late Tuesday in the Delaware Chancery Court, Household said the suit was a "request for declaratory relief regarding...claims relating to the effect of a corporate reorganization under (Delaware law) and claims based on alter ego liability."
Declaratory relief seeks the court's opinion on a legal issue, in this case a finding on whether a corporation was a separate entity or simply a conduit for a private business transaction.
There is no other information at this time because the court does not release lawsuits until they have been served.
Spokespersons at Hoeschst and at the Houston office of Shell had no information about the lawsuit. An attorney for Household was not available for comment.
